metaDesc: God's love, sin and separation, Jesus Christ, the response of faith. Meet the gospel in four scenes on the map, a story that runs from Eden to Golgotha and on to you.
mapAria: The road of the gospel from Eden to Jerusalem
introTag: From Eden to Golgotha, and on to you
introLead: From God's love to the response of faith, meet the gospel in {n} scenes on the map.
wordsIntro: These are the words found in the four scenes of the gospel. Every passage is a fresh rendering in today's language, made to carry the meaning of the original.
endTitle: The good news has reached you
endLead: Thank you for walking with us from Eden to Golgotha, and on to where you are right now.
invite:
Where is Jesus right now? Just as he promised, he has come into your life. He said that if you open the door, he will come in. (Rev 3:20)
You are now a child of God. The proof is not your feelings but his promise. (Jn 1:12)
God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. Whoever has the Son has life. (1 Jn 5:11–12)
Now find a church near you and meet people who will walk this road with you, and open the Bible each day to hear his words. Walking the way of Jesus from the very beginning is also a good place to start.
